How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 passes in a row at 85%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 90 questions in 90 minutes. Pass it and you are ready to book.

Every lesson

The first 10 lessons are open to read here. Every lesson, with its checkpoint, is free inside the course.

Unit 1: Networking Foundations

  1. Networks and Their Types 6 min

On exam day

  • Up to 90 questions in 90 minutes, including performance-based items. Do the multiple choice first if a simulation stalls you; flag and return.
  • Read for the qualifier: MOST likely, BEST, FIRST, NEXT. The methodology questions are about order.
  • Subnet with block sizes on the scratch board. 256 minus the mask octet, then count.
  • Eliminate two options, then decide. Never leave a question blank.
  • Two forms of ID, arrive early, sleep the night before.
